content.text: The migrated code compiles, but it still has dpct helpers and a hard-coded sub-group size of 32. I'll rewrite it with plain SYCL: an `nd_range<1>` launch, `sycl::exp` instead of `native::exp` (to stay within the 1e-6 bar), and a grid-stride loop over sub-groups so the result doesn't depend on the device's sub-group size.

limitations: A successful compile says nothing about numerical correctness; run verify.

input.summary: Ported softmax.cu to plain SYCL 2020 (migrated/softmax.dp.cpp). Compiles with icpx -fsycl with add_dpct_include=false, so no dpct:: helpers, DPCT_* macros, or <dpct/...> includes remain. Changes from the SYCLomatic output: - Replaced the dpct queue/device wrappers with sycl::queue (in-order), sycl::malloc_device/sycl::free, and q.wait(). - Replaced the 3-D nd_range and item_ct1 plumbing with nd_range<1>. - softMax2 (warp-per-slice) no longer hard-codes reqd_sub_group_size(32). It uses sub_group group/local ids and a grid-stride loop over sub-groups, so it is correct for any sub-group size. The launch size (BLOCK_SIZE/32 slices per group) is only a heuristic. - Switched native::exp to sycl::exp so exp accuracy matches expf and stays within the atol=1e-6 bar. - Reductions use sycl::reduce_over_group with sycl::maximum/sycl::plus. Not verified: I have no tool that runs the candidate binary against the CUDA reference output, so the atol=1e-6 match is unconfirmed. Next step is to run build/candidate with the same arguments as the reference and compare the output files (mode=array, atol=1e-6, rtol=0).
